text: {"552":{"about":["rustc_expand","rustc_parse"],"refers":[],"why":"The macro matcher in rustc_expand delegates parsing of metavariable fragments to the main parser in rustc_parse."},"553":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"Macro definition parsing is implemented by rustc_expand's macro_rules module."},"554":{"about":[],"refers":["rustc_expand"],"why":"This only directs readers to implementation comments in a rustc_expand source file."},"555":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"Matching an invocation token stream against macro_rules matchers is declarative-macro parsing implemented in rustc_expand."},"556":{"about":["rustc_expand","rustc_parse"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_expand's macro parser invokes rustc_parse when it must parse a non-terminal fragment."}}
